URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/farage-burnham-general-election-labour-reform-prime-minister-b3017139.html
NOTE: Independent (17 Jul 2026) — Farage demands immediate general election, says Burnham has "no mandate". Verbatim quotes.
Farage: Burnham "says he wants to have the biggest change of direction in politics in 40 years, outside of 25,000 voters in Makerfield he has literally no mandate for this at all." There "must be an immediate general election so the country can decide the future." Claims Reform could produce a "historic upset"; if it fails Britain risks "turning into a third world country" within 10 years.
